requirements.statement: Establish year, region and supported ordinary annual individual-return profile before treatment; screen employment/family/relief branches and explain unsupported circumstances, including joint returns and formal filed-return corrections, while retaining required household facts.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Supported profile and out-of-scope examples independently reviewed.

requirements.statement: Retain ordinary salary and documented benefits-in-kind records for multiple employers separately, compare combined supported fields without double-counting duplicate/superseded records and refer unvalidated special employment treatments.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Independently reviewed multiple-payer facts and field comparisons; duplicate/revised-certificate cases and exact-arithmetic tests.

requirements.statement: Permit a partial review and incomplete packet with prominent unsupported items; leave affected treatments unresolved when required facts are unknown and never imply whole-return validation.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Mixed-scope and unknown-dependency cases, inspected coverage warnings and independently reviewed safe stopping outcomes.

requirements.statement: Admit supported digital/scanned PDFs and standalone images/screenshots; preserve originals, versioned page images and text/image evidence anchors without requiring an embedded text layer.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Supported-format/render/decoder and resource-bound tests; original/derivative/page/region provenance inspection; same-document representation comparison.

requirements.statement: Present visually extracted transcriptions and normalised facts beside reviewable source images; require human confirmation of facts used in proposals, allow version-bound batch confirmation of clear facts and resolve conflicts individually.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Independent field-level values and source/page/region labels; confirmation/version and conflict tests; model confidence never marks a fact confirmed.

requirements.statement: Use only versioned supported rules applicable to year, region and treatment.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Wrong-year/region negative tests and tax-professional review.

requirements.statement: Independently calculate complete tax liability and payable/refundable balance for fully covered 2025 Balearics individual employment/bank-interest cases using confirmed facts and versioned deterministic rules; expose intermediate values and withhold a whole-return result for incomplete coverage.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Independently reviewed end-to-end and intermediate-field calculations, boundary/rounding cases and missing/out-of-scope gates; supplied AEAT totals cannot stand in for an independent result.

requirements.statement: Use exact decimal input and treatment-specific deterministic calculation/rounding.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Reviewed arithmetic/rounding cases and invariant tests.

requirements.statement: Allow evidence preparation without an AEAT draft; publish a proposed draft-field change only with supplied prior draft values, confirmed facts, original/page/region or text evidence, applicable rule and deterministic calculation.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: No-draft preparation and proposal-gate tests; source/confirmation/version validation and semantic review.

requirements.statement: Permit the authenticated case owner to accept, correct or defer exact fresh proposed changes; initially manage professional review through owner-controlled packet export rather than shared accounts.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Authority, freshness, idempotency and audit integration tests.

requirements.statement: Export a readable Spanish PDF review packet and optional structured JSON, distinguishing coverage limits, confirmed facts, proposals, evidence, calculations, unresolved issues and accepted decisions.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Owner walkthrough, PDF rendering/JSON inspection and independent completeness review.

requirements.statement: Guide the case through evidence organisation, fact confirmation, draft checking, supported deduction investigation, proposal review and export, with contextual case questions.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Owner walkthrough of the complete supported journey, including missing evidence and partial coverage; step-level effort and outcome measurements.

requirements.statement: Provide the initial interface and review packet in Spanish, with technical documentation in English.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Owner walkthrough of Spanish screens and packet; technical-documentation inspection.

requirements.statement: Keep case access private and bound tools against untrusted document instructions.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Cross-case/injection tests and deployed identity/access checks.

requirements.statement: Keep sensitive originals, model text, sessions and identifiers outside Git and routine telemetry; keep private reference material, private discovery context and derived taxpayer details local, outside cloud/public examples/external application providers.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Intake/storage/telemetry redaction, local-reference access/egress controls and public-inventory review; reported review remains distinct from inspected labels.

requirements.statement: Recover bounded durable work without duplicate effects or automatic uncertain provider retry.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Crash/duplicate/stale-worker tests and hosted recovery drill.

requirements.statement: Compare baseline and AI on isolated independently reviewed cases with complete outcomes.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Frozen cases/rubric/config and actual hash-bound judgements.

requirements.statement: Explain admission, rendering/decoding, extraction, retrieval, model/tool, validation and recovery outcomes through safe correlated diagnostics.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Inspected traces, finite metrics, alerts and redaction tests.

requirements.statement: Fail closed on absent inference authority and keep calls/time/money bounded.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: No-call default tests and actual bounded execution accounting.

requirements.statement: Reproduce builds and promote verified artifacts through isolated environments.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: CI evidence, artifact identity, environment checks and rollback.
